rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, 2005).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2005 as 'Sally Kane'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, green shading. Cream with champagne tint. Large, full (26-40 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Compact, well-branched. Dark green foliage.

Height: 33" (85cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders or garden. Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.

colour: Cream, green shading. Cream with champagne tint.
